messages:
Oncall-Bot: [ALERT] Incident 1965432100 — Latency SLO breach detected for inference.redwood.prod.us-west-2. p99 > 2.0s sustained for 10m. Streaming stalls metric spiked. Pager routed to SRE. Dashboards: https://grafana/redwood/d/latency?region=us-west-2
Amanda (sre): taking pager, looking now. p95 jumped 120ms -> 380ms, p99 at 2.4s. streaming/stall-count increased ~6x.
Raj (eng-runtime): digging into runtime logs — seeing repeated "KV cache miss" followed by "streaming stall: stall at token 512" correlated to gpunode-42. Linking raw logs: s3://redwood-logs/1965432100/runtime.log
Liam (infra): pulling node metrics for gpunode-42. nvidia-smi shows rising ECC correctables and high temp. Paste snippet: ```nvidia-smi -q -d ECC
GPU 0 : ECC Errors - Corrected: 124, Uncorrected: 0
Temperature: 92 C
Power Draw: 280 W
```
Iris (eng-ml): ML traces show memory page faults and stalls at same timestamps as ECC spikes. dmesg contains "GPU temperature threshold exceeded, reducing clocks" and repeated recoverable ECC messages.
Amanda (sre): customer impact assessment — ~12 customers saw >1% tail latency regression, 2 high-throughput customers reported streaming stalls (CS ticket #7891). Marking impact as PARTIAL/DEGRADED. Notifying support.
Support (triage): acknowledged, posting incident banner and contacting the two customers with the highest error rates.
Liam (infra): proposed immediate mitigation: cordon and drain gpunode-42, steer traffic to fallback pool (region-quantized-v2) to avoid cross-region failover. Commands: ```kubectl cordon gpunode-42 && kubectl drain gpunode-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```
Amanda (sre): executing drain now. Also temporarily reducing streaming chunk window and enabling more aggressive prefix caching while we evacuate the node.
DeployBot: runtime config change started: enabling model fallback policy "region-fallback-quantized" (cfg-id cfg-8822). Rolling to 100% for requests originating from affected nodegroup.
Raj (eng-runtime): hardware note: correctable ECC errors climbing quickly after thermal events — can be precursor to failure. Opening cloud vendor ticket #CV-112233 for RMA/replacement.
Iris (eng-ml): running quick canary for fallback quantized model against production-like traces — latency stable, quality delta ~<2% on our eval prompt set. Approve routing.
Amanda (sre): handing off hardware follow-up to Raj. I'll own postmortem and customer comms. @Raj please ack ownership for replacement coordination.
Raj (eng-runtime): ack. I'll coordinate with cloud vendor and infra for replacement + burn-in tests. Plan: reprovision new instance, run memtest and 12h inference burn-in, validate p99 back to baseline.
Amanda (sre): quick mitigation results: drained gpunode-42, enabled quantized fallback, reduced streaming chunk size to 256 tokens, increased prefix cache TTL. Observed p99 drop from 2.4s -> 560ms within ~8 minutes. Monitoring.
Support (triage): status page updated and customers notified with current mitigation steps and ETA for full recovery.
Liam (infra): collected NVML and kernel dumps: /mnt/logs/1965432100/nvml-dump.tar.gz. Attaching to cloud ticket and shipping to vendor diagnostics.
Raj (eng-runtime): vendor acknowledged payload and RMA. Replacement scheduled in ~6 hours; will track.
Oncall-Bot: Incident 1965432100 status changed: PARTIALLY_MITIGATED — primary mitigation in place (traffic routed to fallback). Owners: Raj (hardware), Amanda (postmortem). Created postmortem ticket PM-1965432100.
Amanda (sre): creating postmortem doc, tagging eng-runtime, eng-ml, infra, and support. Preliminary action items: (1) add ECC-spike early alert (2) publish thermal-throttle runbook for oncall (3) tune fallback thresholds and add canary gating for streaming fallbacks.
Raj (eng-runtime): handing off to daytime oncall @Amanda. I'll move to vendor lane and validate RMA once hardware arrives. Last check: p99 ~0.55s, streaming stall count back to baseline.
Amanda (sre): closing pager for now. Incident marked RESOLVED->monitored. Will reopen if replacement causes regression. :white_check_mark:
